messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — launching two coordinated updates today: 1) a new SDK auto-upgrade opt-in channel (nightly/preview builds) and 2) a small refresh of the interactive docs playground UX + a stricter changelog policy. Details below and action items at the end. :loudspeaker:

elaine: Why — we want teams to test preview SDK builds without surprise upgrades in prod, and we need every docs change to include a changelog entry and migration notes for breaking ops. This reduces regression risk during heavy release weeks.

mike: important — does opt-in mean users get pushed nightly builds automatically once they opt in? or they still have to pull manually?

elainereply (edited): sorry typo — @mike, opt-in means your account (or API key) will receive a nightly tag in the SDK package index and the CLI will surface a `--channel=preview` flag. No forced upgrades. You have to approve in CI/CD or run `rw-sdk upgrade --channel preview`.

sara-docs: for the playground refresh — will previously saved snippets keep working? any schema changes to the playground API?

elainereply: saved snippets remain compatible. We changed the UI for run-time knobs and added a small schema field `runtimeHints` used only by UI for suggested batch sizes. Backward compatible. We'll add migration notes though.

omar: runtime note: the preview SDK includes an experimental batching heuristic (opt-in only). If you enable it via YAML it looks like:

```yaml
inference: 
  batching:
    mode: preview_heuristic
    max_batch: 64
    min_latency_ms: 15
```

omar: enabling preview_heuristic will not change default behavior unless the SDK client is run with `--channel preview` or explicitly set in config.

aisha-legal: flagged for review: telemetry opt-in language. Please ensure the docs show explicit checkbox + example config showing opt-out by default for enterprise customers.

devex-kate: we'll add a short migration guide and a checkbox in the interactive playground that toggles "Use preview SDK builds" with a tooltip: "Recommended for staging; not for production." Also adding a changelog requirement: every docs PR that affects API surface must include a CHANGES.md entry and link to an example prompt suite for regression checks.

mike: timeline? will the docs/SDK changes go out together?

elainereply: rollout plan: day 0 (today) — preview channel published and playground UI rolled to beta; day 3 — email + console banner to projects with >5k tokens/day; day 10 — enforce changelog check in docs CI for any API-surface PRs.

carla: :thumbsup: thanks, good to have the stricter changelog rule.

deploy-bot: deploy:preview sdk/nightly pushed to registry -> tag: rw-sdk@preview-202603 (sha: abcdef123)

devex-kate: action items for docs team: 1) add migration note for runtimeHints, 2) example YAML for the preview batching (use @omar snippet), 3) update interactive playground checkbox text + link to CHANGES.md template. I'll create PRs by EOD.

aisha-legal: I'll review opt-in wording tomorrow morning and post comments in the PR.

elainereply: thanks everyone. If you want to test the preview builds, use `rw-sdk install --channel preview` and file any regressions under the #eng-runtime channel.

elaine: TL;DR: opt-in preview SDK channel + playground UX refresh + stricter changelog policy. Expect separate follow-up PRs for docs and a short RFC on the changelog enforcement rule.
